- `hcomm` and `hcentral` both apply `congrArg` to `hzcen` and simplify.

Across the repository I grepped for other uses of `mem_img148_iff`, of the Sylow conjugation pattern (`exists_smul_eq`), and of `X ⊔ pPrimeCoreOf 3 Y`. I found no other proof that repeats the `hkey` characterisation (`mk' u ∈ img148 A Y X ↔ u ∈ X ⊔ pPrimeCoreOf 3 Y`) or the Sylow-conjugation argument in `false_of_le_centralizer_of_rank_two`. The closest hit was `le_normalizer_sup_of_normal_image` in F17LeafCore.lean. It is a different statement (it concerns the pPrimeCore quotient, not img148), and I did not find a repeated block there. The other `exists_smul_eq` call sites are in unrelated contexts. I did not read every one of them in full, so a repeat I missed there is still possible.
